body: GAP to absorb (2026-06-12): the manufacture list covers CLDR month_name/abbreviated_month + ISO currency_code/currency_symbol, but MISSES (a) the 12 finance.currency.amount_* FORMAT variants (CLDR number-format: per-locale grouping/decimal/symbol-position) and (b) the datetime locale-format month/weekday variants (long_full_month, weekday_abbreviated_month, weekday_full_month — audit locale-gap validators). These are the same locale-format-recognition family as currency and the ideal CharCNN-vs-multi-branch low-collateral pilot. Tracked in spec 2026-06-12-currency-variant-recognition ac-02; memory training-data-gap-locale-format-family.
